accounts.title: Linked Accounts
accounts.description: Manage your connected OAuth providers and set your primary account for profile synchronization
accounts.primaryDescription: This account is used for profile synchronization
accounts.unlinkConfirmDescription: Are you sure you want to unlink your {provider} account? You can always link it again later.
accounts.unlinkBlockedLastSignInMethod: This is the only way to sign in to your account, so it cannot be unlinked.
accounts.emailSignInSwitchedOff: Email sign-in is turned off. This address still identifies your account.
accounts.allProvidersLinked: All available providers are already linked to your account

profileSync.title: Profile Sync
profileSync.description: Synchronize your profile information from your primary OAuth provider
profileSync.cannotSyncInfo: Set an OAuth provider as your primary to enable profile synchronization
profileSync.syncSuccessDescription: Your profile has been updated from your primary provider
profileSync.syncErrorDescription: Failed to sync profile. Please try again later

password.title: Change Password
password.description: Update your account password. You'll be logged out of other sessions.
password.newPasswordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters
password.newPasswordUppercase: Password must contain at least one uppercase letter
password.newPasswordLowercase: Password must contain at least one lowercase letter
password.newPasswordNumber: Password must contain at least one number

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: Ask for a code from an authenticator app at every sign-in.

reauth.description: Confirm it is you before changing how you sign in.
reauth.passwordBody: Enter your current password to continue.
reauth.passwordlessBody: Your account has no password, so the session you signed in on is the proof. Sign in again if this is refused.

scan.description: Add the account to your authenticator app.
scan.body: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or type the key below into it.
scan.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app

confirm.description: Enter the first code your app shows.
confirm.body: Your app now shows a six digit code that changes every 30 seconds.

recoveryCodes.body: Each code signs you in once if you lose your authenticator app. They are shown here and nowhere else.

disable.title: Turn off two-step verification?
disable.description: Sign-in stops asking for a code. You can turn it back on later.

regenerate.title: Replace recovery codes
regenerate.description: The old codes stop working, used or not.
regenerate.done: Here are your new codes. The old ones no longer work.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of a password.
passkeys.noPlatformAuthenticator: This device has no built-in authenticator. A security key or your phone works too.
passkeys.empty: No passkeys yet. Add one to sign in without a password.

name.title: Name this passkey
name.description: The name shows here only, to tell your passkeys apart.

rename.title: Rename passkey
rename.description: Pick a name that tells you which device this is.
rename.label: Rename {name}

delete.title: Remove this passkey?
delete.description: {name} stops working for sign-in. The key stays on your device until you delete it there.
delete.label: Remove {name}
delete.blockedLastSignInMethod: This is the only way to sign in to your account, so it cannot be removed.

errors.nameTooLong: A name can be at most {max} characters

profile.title: Profile Information
profile.name: Full Name
profile.nameMinLength: Name must be at least 2 characters

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage your account settings and preferences
